name: HistogramPanel
description:
Glass UX Histogram fed by readPreview, including uncommitted slider drafts. RGB is one histogram
with a series per channel, each in its own colour, screen-blended so where channels agree reads as neutral.
signature: ({ editor, maxEdge, bins: fixedBins, channel, defaultChannel, onChannelChange, className }: HistogramPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: bins
props.description: Bin count. By default it follows the chart's width, about one column per 7 pixels, so columns stay legible at any size.

props.name: defaultChannel
props.description: Starting channel when uncontrolled: the red, green and blue channels overlaid by default.

props.name: maxEdge
props.description: Preview maximum edge in pixels; defaults to 192.
